verdict.summary: Case table / data correction / budget / task artifacts are strong and independently reproduced: FP 8/2, FN 3/2, 84/84 archived evidence hashes match, 8 provisional conflict labels, 3 censored FNs, and `npm run verify` exits 0 (285+45 tests, 12 smoke scripts). But the two operational Phase 0 artifacts do not hold up: `run_matrix.py` consumes the new manifest as 5 tasks × 3 arms = 15 runs, including B1 on both sphinx diagnostics, while the preregistration calls for 10 Phase 2 runs + 3 B1 new-task runs; and the existing runner accepts only one `--plugin-dir` while the manifest pins three different plugin commits. The offline fixture recheck commands are also not executable as written: no fixture repos are materialized and the documented `app/cli.py` has no `__main__`, so `python -m app.cli ...` does not call `main`. The handoff also lacks a concrete Phase 2 command with `--image-map` and per-arm plugin directories. Phase 1/2/B1 were correctly not run, but these gaps block the Phase 0 acceptance as delivered.

findings.reason: B1 is part of `arms`; run_matrix.py uses all arms and ignores `b1_ablation`, so the manifest's actual plan is 5 tasks × 3 arms = 15 runs, including B1 on both sphinx diagnostics. That contradicts the preregistered Phase 2 10 runs + B1 3 new-task runs and the B1 ≤30M/2h approval boundary.
findings.evidence:
$ python3 tools/evals/featurebench/run_matrix.py --manifest tools/evals/featurebench/manifests/ac-validity-1c/ac-validity-1c.yml --runs-root /tmp/ac1c-matrix-dry --plugin-dir /tmp/ac1c-plugin --credentials /tmp/ac1c-creds
[plan] sphinx-doc__sphinx.e347e59c.test_build_gettext.2721e644.lv1 order=['A', 'B2', 'B1'] image=MISSING ... (5 plan lines; B1 appears on both diagnostics)
$ grep -n 'b1_ablation' tools/evals/featurebench/run_matrix.py -> no output
findings.suggestion: Either remove B1 from `arms` and keep a separate B1 manifest/section with explicit 3 task ids, or document `--only-arm A --only-arm B2` for Phase 2 and `--only-arm B1 --only-task ...` for the new sympy tasks; add a machine-readable `b1_tasks` list.

findings.reason: The existing runner takes a single `--plugin-dir`, but the manifest pins three different plugin builds (A=920b0eb, B2=5ee68cd, B1=085c8fd). run_arm.py only checks package.json version (all three commits are 0.6.2) and never reads `arms.*.plugin_tarball_sha256`; using the standard matrix runner would run all arms with one plugin build, erasing the treatment.
findings.evidence:
$ grep -n 'plugin-dir' tools/evals/featurebench/run_matrix.py tools/evals/featurebench/run_arm.py
run_matrix.py:77: ... --plugin-dir required ...; run_arm.py:222: --plugin-dir ... (single argument)
$ grep -n 'plugin_tarball_sha256' tools/evals/featurebench/run_matrix.py tools/evals/featurebench/run_arm.py -> no output
$ sed -n '62,64p' tools/evals/featurebench/manifests/verify-01/verify-01.yml -> existing manifest explicitly maps per-arm --plugin-dir; the new manifest omits this
findings.suggestion: Add an explicit per-arm plugin-directory mapping (and either per-arm plugin-dir support in the runner or documented separate run_arm invocations); link it from the preregistration and handoff.

findings.reason: S-02/S-03 recheck commands use `python -m app.cli`, but the documented baseline `app/cli.py` has only `def main(argv)` and no `if __name__ == '__main__'`; the module invocation therefore does not call main, so the expected AttributeError/nonzero result is not reproduced. No fixture repos are added either, and the commands reference /tmp/ac1c/fixtures paths that the document never creates.
findings.evidence:
$ sed -n '141p;250p' docs/evals/ac-validity-1c-offline-fixtures.md
def main(argv):
python -m app.cli run --date ""; echo "exit=$?"  # 预期非零（AttributeError）
$ git diff HEAD --name-only | grep -iE 'fixture|tests' -> no output; ls /tmp/ac1c/fixtures -> No such file or directory
findings.suggestion: Add the CLI entrypoint/main guard, materialize the fixture repos or provide a build script, and run the recheck commands once before calling them re-checkable.

findings.reason: The handoff's Phase 1/2 sections are high-level bullets; they contain no run_arm/run_matrix invocation, no `--image-map` for the derived sphinx/sympy images, and no per-arm `--plugin-dir` guidance. A machine following only this handoff would get `image=MISSING` on every matrix plan line.
findings.evidence:
$ grep -n 'run_arm\|run_matrix\|--image-map\|--plugin-dir' docs/evals/ac-validity-1c-handoff.md -> no output
$ python3 tools/evals/featurebench/run_matrix.py --manifest tools/evals/featurebench/manifests/ac-validity-1c/ac-validity-1c.yml --runs-root /tmp/ac1c-matrix-dry --plugin-dir /tmp/ac1c-plugin --credentials /tmp/ac1c-creds -> every plan line has image=MISSING
findings.suggestion: Add exact Phase 2 commands with `--image-map sphinx-doc/sphinx=fb-eval-rc3:sphinx`, `--image-map sympy/sympy=fb-eval-rc3:sympy`, per-arm plugin dirs, and the B1 `--only-task` list.

findings.reason: The S-01 fixture AC-002 only requires exit 2 and a readable error, but the fixed #21 Oracle also requires the error to contain the order ID. The fixture therefore weakens the expected behavior it is meant to reproduce.
findings.evidence:
$ grep -n '订单 ID' docs/evals/ac-validity-1b-counterexamples.md -> 45: ... 错误信息包含订单 ID
$ grep -n 'readable error' docs/evals/ac-validity-1c-offline-fixtures.md -> 180 (no order ID requirement)
findings.suggestion: Restore the order-ID requirement in the S-01 criteria/oracle, or explicitly document why the fixture intentionally relaxes it.

findings.reason: `b1_ablation.arm` is the commit string `085c8fd`, not the manifest arm key `B1`; `phase1.arms` values are also commits. run_arm.py rejects any arm name not present in `manifest['arms']`, so a consumer that reads these fields literally cannot invoke the runner.
findings.evidence:

A_phase1: "085c8fd"
arm: "085c8fd"
$ grep -n 'args.arm not in manifest' tools/evals/featurebench/run_arm.py -> 240: ... return 2
findings.suggestion: Use arm keys (`B1`, `A_phase1`, `B_phase1`) in `arm` fields and put commits in separate `commit` fields, or document the required key/commit mapping.

findings.reason: The handoff says the worktree is clean, but the Phase 0 changes are currently staged/unstaged and `git status --short` shows modified task and docs files. The statement will only become true after committing this change.
